names: Eagle Farm Women's Prison and Factory Site
Eagle Farm Women’s Prison and Factory (1838)
mapIdentity.scope: The 1837 letter supplies the outer stockade dimensions and single gate. Present archaeological-park boundaries, the interpreted barracks/store/school positions and quarters marker tie the reconstructed group to its general site.

note: The 1839 inventory and excavation report supply the building types, timber slab and selected plaster surfaces, double enclosure, and scattered brick evidence. Historic buildings use modern terrain only as a display substrate, preserving all raw measurements.
